bosses.name: The Prophet Skeram
bosses.general: Splits into three at 75%, 50% and 25%: kill the real one (the illusions die with it). Arcane Explosion, Earth Shock, and True Fulfillment mind controls.
bosses.tank: One tank on each copy, spread on the platforms.
bosses.healer: Crowd control or sheep the mind controlled.
bosses.dps: Interrupt Arcane Explosion; find and burn the real Skeram.

bosses.name: Lord Kri
bosses.general: The Bug Trio: Kri (cleave, poison cloud when he dies), Yauj (fears, heals the others) and Vem (charges, knock backs). Kill Kri and Yauj, Vem last.
bosses.healer: Interrupt Yauj's heals; heal through the poison.
bosses.dps: Kri first away from the raid, Yauj second, Vem last.

bosses.name: Princess Yauj
bosses.general: Bug Trio: fears and Great Heal on the others; her death releases brood bugs.
bosses.dps: Interrupt her heals; area attacks on her brood when she dies.

bosses.name: Vem
bosses.general: Bug Trio: Charge and Knock Away. He enrages when the others die: kill him last.
bosses.tank: Hold him away from the raid.

bosses.name: Battleguard Sartura
bosses.general: With three Sartura's Royal Guards: all of them Whirlwind. Stun the guards, kill them, then Sartura. Enrages after 10 minutes.
bosses.tank: One tank per guard and Sartura; pick them back up after a whirlwind.
bosses.dps: Stun the guards in turn; guards first, then Sartura.

bosses.name: Fankriss the Unyielding
bosses.general: Mortal Wound stacks on the tank; worms spawn at the tunnels and entangle and kill players fast.
bosses.tank: Two or three tanks swap at Mortal Wound stacks.
bosses.dps: Kill the spawned worms at once.

bosses.name: Viscidus
bosses.general: Freeze him with frost damage (200 frost hits), then shatter him with melee. He splits into globs: kill them before they rejoin. Poison bolt volley.
bosses.dps: Frost spells and frost weapons to freeze him, melee to shatter, then kill the globs.

bosses.name: Princess Huhuran
bosses.general: Wyvern Sting puts people to sleep, Acid Spit stacks on the tank, Noxious Poison; Frenzy and berserk at 30%.
bosses.tank: Nature resistance; tanks swap if acid stacks high.
bosses.healer: Nature resistance; heavy raid damage at 30%.
bosses.dps: Hunters Tranq the frenzy; burn her from 30%.

bosses.name: Emperor Vek'lor
bosses.general: Twin Emperors: Vek'lor casts (Shadow Bolt, Blizzard, Arcane Burst), immune to physical damage; Vek'nilash fights in melee, immune to spells. They teleport and swap; kept close they heal.
bosses.tank: A warlock tanks Vek'lor with Shadow Bolt; warriors take Vek'nilash. Swap sides after each teleport.
bosses.healer: Stay out of Blizzard, keep spread; pace your mana.
bosses.dps: Casters on Vek'lor, melee on Vek'nilash; keep the two apart.

bosses.name: Emperor Vek'nilash
bosses.general: Twin Emperors: Vek'nilash only takes physical damage, Uppercut, Unbalancing Strike. Bugs he touches explode (Mutate Bug).
bosses.tank: Warrior tanks pick him up after each teleport.
bosses.healer: Heal the tank through Unbalancing Strike.
bosses.dps: Melee on Vek'nilash; casters on Vek'lor.

bosses.name: Ouro
bosses.general: Sand Blast in front, Sweep knocks back the melee. He submerges and pops up somewhere else; scarabs come out. Berserk at 20%.
bosses.tank: Face him away; pick him up where he surfaces.
bosses.healer: Heal the sweep and the sand blast.
bosses.dps: Never in front; kill the scarabs; ranged pick him up when he surfaces.

bosses.name: C'Thun
bosses.general: Phase 1: the eye's Dark Glare sweeps the room, Eye Beam chains: spread in a circle 10 yards apart, kill Eye Tentacles. Phase 2: players are eaten into his stomach; kill the flesh tentacles inside.
bosses.tank: Pick up the Giant Claw Tentacles.
bosses.healer: Everyone spread; heal the eye beams.
bosses.dps: Spread, move out of Dark Glare, tentacles first; in phase 2 the eaten kill the stomach tentacles.
